_doc: Capability to model id. Every LLM call resolves its model here; an unmapped capability falls back to 'default'. VIVIFY_MODEL_OVERRIDE wins over this map. A family alias (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable) tracks the newest release and is pinned to its concrete id once per run (vivify_core.pin_model) - the concrete id, not the alias, is what _model records.
